thread:
lily: Hi all, new here! Trying to run a quick embeddings job against ~120k local markdown files to prototype search. Using my hosted sandbox key but getting repeated 429s after a few minutes. Any fast paths for a short, one-off increase? I just need ~90 minutes.

infra-bot: FYI hosted sandbox keys are rate/volume limited to prevent abuse. Short-lived increases are handled by infra ops. Email infra@redwood.com with subject 'sandbox-temp-increase' and include: team, account id, token id (if you can), expected total tokens, estimated qps, and duration. Typical auto-approvals for <= 5M tokens and <= 3h.

lily: Perfect, thanks. Is there an internal form or ticket I should open instead?

dave: Hey @lily, no form. Email infra first. If you want lower friction, I can create a one-time ephemeral token (1.5h) scoped to embeddings only. I need the run window and cost center. Ephemeral tokens show up in audit logs.

alina: If you don't want to upload data, consider sampling and running locally with a smaller batch to validate the pipeline before the full run. Sampling saved me hours when I was onboarding.

lily: OK I can sample, but plan still needs full run for quality checks. Dave, can I get the ephemeral token? Window tomorrow 09:30-11:00 PDT. Cost center: "eng-experiments".

devx-harry: quick security note: if you upload any data to tmp buckets, mark the S3 object as non-public and set lifecycle 7d. Also annotate if data contains customer PII.

ops-ryan: tagging ops. We'll need to attach charge code and set expected spend cap. Lily, roughly how many calls/sec do you expect?

lily: Estimated burst ~15 qps, avg ~6 qps. Total tokens ~2.8M.

dave: Sounds fine. I'll issue a token and DM it to you. Reminder: do not paste tokens in public channels. I'll post once issued (no token text) and infra will get the email for record.

lily: Thanks everyone! Very helpful :slightly_smiling_face:
